mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a waxing crescent moon. Also, look up at 7:40 PM for an ISS flyover, which will appear in the west southwest near Mount Horeb and track high across the sky toward the northeast near the Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

Verona police released a report regarding an incident on September 10th. Officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress, where they located a suspect and recovered a handgun. The individual was taken to a hospital for treatment and faces charges of burglary and reckless endangerment.

It is a busy couple of days in the city! Today features the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, plus live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is a yoga session at Insight Wellness, followed by a week filled with trivia and music at spots like Hop Haus, Paddy Mac's, and the downtown Farmer's Market.
On Wednesday, September 10th, local officers successfully took a suspect into custody following a burglary call on Hunter's Cove Way.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the popular Really Reese's. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
